name: a_depth_alone_makes_the_hole_blind
why: SCENARIO t15 (27/10/2026): a «cylindrical_cut» with «depth_mm» 5 and no «through_all» drilled through the 20 mm block (1570.8 mm3 removed, pi x 5^2 x 20), because «through_all» defaulted to true and the depth was dropped without a word. A depth given alone is a blind cut now; «through_all» true written beside a depth still wins (the pair case limit_pocket_that_covers_everything sends both on purpose). Block 100 x 60 x 20: a 6 mm hole with «through_all» true and a depth goes through, then a 10 mm hole 5 deep removes pi x 5^2 x 5. The blind one second: afterwards its bottom is another «up» face and the selector would become ambiguous. Volumes computed by script.
defect_caught: A depth given without «through_all» that drills through; «through_all» true that no longer wins over a depth.

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 120000 minus pi x 3^2 x 20

expect.why: through_all written beside the depth wins

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: minus pi x 5^2 x 5

expect.why: the depth alone makes it blind
